description: Nnamdi Chukwuocha, as the State Representative in Delaware's 1st district, has maintained strong community and legislative support by working hard to become a valued member of the General Assembly, the Wilmington Delegation, and the Delaware Legislative Black Caucus by fighting for the priorities and values of our district and state including business, community and housing development, education, healthcare, our veterans and seniors.
title: Nnamdi for Delaware | State Representative in Delaware's 1st district
